title: ಶರಣರ ವಚನಗಳು
author: ಶಿವಶರಣರು
description: ಕಲ್ಯಾಣದ ಅನುಭವಮಂಟಪದ ಶಿವಶರಣ ಚೆನ್ನಬಸವಣ್ಣನವರ ೨೯ ಆಯ್ದ ವಚನಗಳು — ಆಚಾರ-ಕಾಯಕ, ಗುರು-ಲಿಂಗ-ಜಂಗಮ, ಡಾಂಭಿಕ ಪೂಜೆ ಮತ್ತು ಜಾತಿ-ವೇದಾಭಿಮಾನದ ವಿಡಂಬನೆ. ಅಂಕಿತ: ಕೂಡಲಚೆನ್ನಸಂಗಮದೇವ.

provenance.licenseNote: The Shivasharanas of this anthology all died in the 12th century (authorDied recorded as 1200 as a conservative century-end date; Chennabasavanna died in the Kalyana upheaval c. 1167-1196). Text is public domain worldwide. Taken from the Kannada Wikisource edition: the vachana-literature index above links author pages; this selection uses one page per vachana from the Chennabasavanna author index. Exact pages are listed in sources.txt. Only the vachana text was taken; line breaks re-flowed at sentence ends where the import had split lines at commas. Other listed 12th-century sharanas (Jedara Dasimayya, Siddharama, Madivala Machideva, Ambiga Chowdayya, and others) do not yet have 15+ proofread individual vachana pages on kn.wikisource, so they are not included.
